best_match.fbbt_definition: Surface-associated glial cell of the optic lobe that is part of a layer found below the perineurial and subperineurial optic lobe glia (Morante et al., 2013). These cells can be identified by their relatively large nuclei and are found from third instar through to adult stages (Morante et al., 2013). They are cell body glial cells (Morante et al., 2013; Plazaola-Sasieta et al., 2019).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00111302 'optic-lobe-associated cortex glial cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
